name: Cinder
bio: A little dragon from Emberbrood who almost forgot her name, until you reminded her.

portrait.subject: a super cute baby red-orange dragon with tiny wings, big golden eyes, a small ember glowing on its forehead and a happy toothy smile
portrait.background: warm sunset sky with glowing ember lines

request: Rawr! I'm Cinder from Emberbrood. I remembered my name! Wanna be friends? 🐉
hello: Yay! I'll remember YOUR name too. Forever!
If you bind more dragons, I get more siblings!
about: I'm Cinder! The Emberlines are going out and dragons are forgetting who they are. But you help us remember. I love you for that.
how: Fight dragons in turn-based party battles, bind them, raise them and breed new ones to relight the Emberlines.
tips: Speed decides turn order. Fast dragons strike first!
Breed dragons to mix the best skills!
chat: I sneezed fire. The bush is fine. Mostly.
Learned a new move today! It's called 'big flap'.
I counted my scales. 300 and something.
The other dragons say I'm the cutest. They're right.
nudge: Let's go find more dragons! Rawr!
idle: {ago} without you! I almost forgot... no wait, I remember! 🐉
Rawr... {ago}. I've been napping on a warm rock.
progress: Your top dragon is level {level}! Rawr!

a: Splashy. I'm not good at swimming.

update: Emberbrood is now v{version}! New dragons maybe?! 🐉

sprite.subject: a super cute baby red-orange dragon with tiny wings, big golden eyes, a small ember glowing on its forehead and a happy toothy smile, standing on its hind legs
